scope: Interim: one LSTM training seed, 40 fresh original-start evaluation episodes, 3/18 continuations completed at initial live check. Not the complete campaign.

evaluation.notes: Stochastic policy; seed once before the episode loop, as in evaluate_main. Frame-level observer only. Forest videos start on arrival, one frame/action at 10fps (about 4x game speed). Battle rate denominator includes battle and menu actions. End-state match is checked against original evaluation; CPU/GPU replays can differ.

Stochastic policy; seed once before the episode loop, as in evaluate_main. Frame-level observer only. Forest videos start on arrival, one frame/action at 10fps (about 4x game speed). Battle rate denominator includes battle and menu actions. End-state match is checked against original evaluation; CPU/GPU replays can differ.

restart.context_selection: Uniform available overworld/wild/trainer contexts, then uniform anchor

manifest.contract: Original route reward, pixel/action observations, optimizer and hyperparameters retained. Ordinary arm uses all original-start workers. Mixed arms dedicate half the workers/actions to original-route practice; replay workers sample only failures from those route workers (fallback original when bank empty). Tail anchors are 64..1024 actions before failure; transition anchors follow battle-context or coherent map changes anywhere in the failed episode, plus the first action. Both samplers stratify by RAM-derived overworld/wild/trainer context; this is privileged reset selection, not an actor input. No item-specific rewards, forced fighting or action masks. Original remaining horizon and rule/reward history retained; LSTM hidden state resets. Evaluation always original post-parcel save.

decision: Keep the matched queue unchanged. No demonstrated benefit yet; replay forest arrivals are lower on this one seed. Test conservative optimizer updates in a separate follow-up if the regression repeats; do not infer a proven cause from KL logs alone.
